Method of Attack: Disguised as legitimate Android apps installing adware
Distributed as fake security software, game cracks, cheats, VPN software, Netflix, and utility apps on third-party sites
Stealth installation via APKs from third-party websites
Apps display ads by retrieving advertisement URLs from attacker servers
Apps register Android intents to launch on device boot or unlock
Potential to switch adware URLs to malware such as banking Trojans or ransomware
Attack Vector: Installation of malicious APKs from third-party websites outside Google Play
Malicious spyware SDK embedded in apps on Google Play
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps not hosted on Google Play but on third-party sites
UTF-8 character in app label to evade detection
Error message 'Application is unavailable in your region. Tap OK to uninstall' shown by malicious apps
Malicious apps register intents to launch on boot or unlock
Malicious spyware SDK installed over 400 million times on Android devices from Google Play apps
